verdict.rationale: Supabase's own docs say pgvector, a Postgres extension, provides vector similarity search and embedding storage inside the project database, so no separate vector database is needed. The agent-skills catalog also lists a Vectors area. Missing for 10: indexing and performance details (e.g., index types, scale limits), query/API usage examples, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can store embeddings and run vector similarity search natively without adding a separate vector database

citations.quote: pgvector is a Postgres extension for vector similarity search. It can also be used for storing embeddings.
